# Official Multiwfn VMD templates

These unmodified `.vmd` files come from `examples/` in the official
Multiwfn 3.8(dev) Windows distribution, inspected on 2026-09-20.
Upstream distribution: <http://sobereva.com/multiwfn/>.
The original Multiwfn terms in the repository's `LICENSE.txt` apply.

They are reference fixtures for the surface dataset, coloring dataset,
color range, BGR color scale and optional midpoint. The integration test reads
these files directly instead of defining a second table of expected ranges.
See [the rendering contract](../../../docs/matterviz-weak-interactions.md).
